componentRules.body: display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3);
font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--text-xl); margin: 0; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.005em;
display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--space-2);
font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--text-6xl); font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1;
display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--space-3);
background: var(--moz-blue-50); color: var(--moz-blue-800); border-color: var(--moz-blue-100);
background: var(--ink); color: white; border-color: var(--ink);
background: var(--success); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--success-bg); animation: dot-pulse 1.8s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;

componentRules.selector: /* Trailing element inside .input--with-icon (right side, e.g. show/hide, ⌘K) */ .input--with-icon .input-trailing
/* Autocomplete dropdown — appears under the Search docs input */ .autocomplete-panel

/* ═══ Choice cards (onboarding single/multi-select) ══════ */ /* Vertical stack of full-width selectable cards: icon + title + subtitle + radio indicator. Like Ferndesk's "Welcome" screen. */ .choice-stack
/* Value pills shown INSIDE the combobox trigger when multi-selected */ .combobox-trigger .combobox-value

componentRules.body: color: var(--slate-500); transition: transform var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out); flex-shrink: 0;
